# About
Packaging Team is a wholesale supplier of aluminium foil based in Hungary, serving customers across the European Union. We stock aluminium foil rolls in thicknesses from 6.35 to 50 microns and widths from 565mm to 1250mm. Our warehouse in Hungary enables fast EU-wide delivery.

# Products
## Aluminium Foil Rolls
- Thickness range: 6.35 microns to 50 microns
- Available thicknesses: 6.35µ, 7µ, 8µ, 9µ, 12µ, 37µ, 40µ
- Width range: 565mm to 1250mm
- Sold by weight (kilograms) and reels (rolls)
- Suitable for: food packaging, pharmaceutical packaging, insulation, lamination, industrial applications, converter foils

## Thickness Guide
- 6.35µ — Ultra-thin converter foil for lamination and flexible packaging
- 7µ — Thin foil for flexible packaging and wrapping
- 8µ — Standard thin foil for food packaging and lamination
- 9µ — Medium-thin foil for general packaging applications
- 12µ — Medium foil for food containers and household foil
- 37µ — Heavy-duty foil for insulation and industrial applications
- 40µ — Extra heavy-duty foil for demanding industrial uses
- 50µ — Maximum thickness available, for specialized industrial applications

# Services
- Wholesale aluminium foil supply across all 27 EU member states
